C1841.title: Shanghai Police Dismantle Two Game-Cheat Software Manufacturing and Sales Gangs
C1841.summary: In August 2024, Shanghai Jinshan Branch discovered a game streamer using cheat software during livestreamed matches of a popular game to attract traffic and selling cheats for profit, and formed a task force. In September 2024, the team apprehended cheat developer Ji, online seller Wang, and offline resellers Wang Ci and Li across Anhui, Hunan, and Guizhou, dismantling the gang behind the "Panda" cheat. In November 2024, the Ministry of Public Security publicized the case, with two game-cheat gangs fully disrupted across the chain.
